title: Master and Imran try to study for an exam but keep getting distracted
custom_script:
# Scene: classroom (sitting)
Imran: Okay Master, no phones, no snacks, only studying! [happy, point, ding]
Master: Deal. Chapter one… wait, is that a samosa smell? [suspicious, think]
Imran: Focus! The exam is tomorrow! [angry, hips, slap]
Master: I am focused… on the samosa. [happy, shrug, eat]
# Scene: home (sitting)
Imran: Two hours later and we finished… one page. [sad, shrug, fail]
Master: Relax, I have a genius plan. [suspicious, wave]
Imran: Please tell me it's studying. [surprised, point]
Master: Sleeping with the book under my pillow! [happy, idle, snore]
